scan_lineage.scope: Monotonic ROS scan-handler entry to publication of the request built from that exact scan. Includes queued Agent/map processing; excludes transport before callback and Agent consumption after publication. Receipt gaps are not DDS-loss evidence.

scope: Worker submission and exact scan-callback-entry to field publication are distinct wall-time intervals. No DDS-arrival or Agent-reaction claim. Worker histories retain up to 10000 publications; LiDAR processing retains its last 2000 samples.
